app.name: Teach Us to Pray
app.description: Learn to pray in your own words, following the pattern Jesus gave in the Lord's Prayer.

welcome.heading: Teach Us to Pray
body: Each step shows the words of Jesus and asks you a question.
You answer in your own words. The app never writes a prayer for you.

step.moreLink: More from Scripture for this step
step.inputHint: Write as much or as little as you like. You may leave this blank.

steps.name: Come to the Father
steps.prompt: You are speaking to the one true God, your Father. How do you want to address him?

steps.name: Honor his name
steps.prompt: What about God do you honor or thank him for?

steps.name: His kingdom and will
steps.prompt: Where do you want his will done: in the world, your family, you?

steps.name: Daily bread
steps.prompt: What do you need for today? Who else needs provision?

steps.name: Forgive us
steps.prompt: What do you need forgiveness for? Who do you need to forgive?

steps.name: Keep us and deliver us
steps.prompt: Where do you need strength or protection?
steps.note: The World English Bible prints one more sentence in this verse, with a footnote that some Greek texts omit it. It is not shown here.

prayer.heading: Your prayer
prayer.intro: These are your own words, in the order Jesus taught.
prayer.empty: You have not written anything yet. Go back to any step and add your own words.
prayer.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

draft.heading: Saving
draft.toggle: Keep my draft on this device
draft.explain: Off by default. When on, your words are kept in this browser on this device only. They are never sent anywhere.
draft.eraseConfirm: Erase everything you have written, here and on this device?

about.heading: About and privacy
who: This app exists only to serve the ministry of Jesus, the Son of God. It shows how he taught us to pray, so that you can pray in your own words.
It is free. There are no ads, no accounts, no donations and no tracking.
privacy: What you write never leaves your device. The app has no server, sends nothing over the internet, and uses no cookies or analytics.
Nothing is saved unless you turn on "Keep my draft on this device". If you do, your words are stored only in this browser, and "Erase my words" removes them.
sources: The structure follows the prayer Jesus taught in Matthew 6:5-15 and Luke 11:1-4. Every other quotation is Scripture, shown with its reference.
Scripture quotations are from the World English Bible (WEB), which is in the public domain. The text was taken from eBible.org. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org.
Where a reference ends in "a" or "b", only that part of the verse is shown. The words shown are unchanged.
The app adds no teaching of its own. The only words that are ours are the step names, the questions, the buttons and this page.
about.doxology: The World English Bible prints one more sentence at the end of Matthew 6:13, with a footnote that some Greek texts omit it. This app does not show that sentence.
